messages:
joel_sales: FYI Caspian Analytics signed a short POC. Theyre bringing a QLoRA-13B variant, want EU-only residency + BYOK, and target p95 <=200ms for ~1500 token responses. Need catalog fit, quick price estimate, and security answers.
maya_ops: Dedicated eu-west will be fastest to spin up. Private if they insist on HSM-backed BYOK. We should try Dedicated + customer BYOK via peered KMS for the POC.
diego_eng: For adapter onboarding we need: adapter tar.gz, base model name, tokenizer.json, sample prompts, and any custom ops list. If custom ops present we may need a runtime image build (adds ~3 business days).
joel_sales: I'll ask them to upload artifacts today.
rachel_sec: Security checklist: BYOK flow doc, IP allowlist for VPC peering, EU data residency statement, and our SOC2 attestation. I can draft quick answers.
diego_eng: Perf note: With int8 on 3xA100-80GB we estimate p95 ~170-210ms for 1.5k tokens. If they need consistent <160ms consider 4-bit or extra nodes. Will run a microbenchmark once we have the adapter.
joel_sales: Pricing: they want a POC quote for 3 weeks, ~30k gen tokens/day. Any back-of-envelope?
maya_ops: Rough: $5k setup + $2.5k/week reserved pool + usage at dedicated rates. I'll prepare a compact estimate.
quote-bot: Created ticket POC-3184 Caspian onboarding (assignees: maya_ops, diego_eng, rachel_sec)
joel_sales: Action items: 1) Joel to collect artifacts and schedule kickoff (today). 2) Diego to run adapter scan (48h). 3) Maya to draft POC quote (24h). 4) Rachel to prepare security FAQ (48h).
maya_ops: Ack. If adapter requires native ops we'll notify and adjust timeline.
joel_sales: Thanks team — aim for a week 1 demo if perf looks good. :thumbsup:
